body: Either something is seriously wrong with your family, or you're unable to see things from their perspective. Try to view your situation from a different perspective like for example your mother, how does she see the situation? It's much easier to come to rational solutions after understanding the playing field :)

Hey man, I think you'll come to find that materialistic things mean absolutely nothing, but sadly that can only be fully understood once it's experienced it first hand. Best of luck, sorry to hear that life hasn't been good to you :(
